title: [nightly/speed] Send the dashboard's three reads to the database together
summary: The dashboard stops re-reading the signed-in golfer and runs its three independent database reads at once instead of one after another. That's about a third faster when the database is 10–20 ms away (204 → 137 ms) and a few ms when it's on the same network; the response is byte-identical.
stillOpen: Couldn't open the PR: the run had no GitHub access. Written against frontend-refactor before the redesign merge, so it needs porting onto factory/speed.
reviewFirst: Three pool connections per dashboard load (pool max 10).
user = current_user, safe because the route 403s unless they're the same golfer.
